metadata.name: TCM Intake Triage
metadata.description: Classify a TCM intake document, extract structured patient-facing fields, route by validation and confidence outcome.
metadata.rationale: Shadow TCM archetype for intake and triage workflows. Keeps the original classify / code extract / condition route skeleton while testing high-PII healthcare-adjacent copy.

nodes.rationale: Manual intake review starts from an uploaded patient questionnaire or visit note.
Classify the intake document so the deterministic extractor can apply the right field map.
nodes.system_prompt: Classify the TCM intake document. Return only the JSON object.

nodes.rationale: Extract structured triage fields while keeping validation deterministic and reviewable.
Route clean intake records forward and send uncertain or invalid records to human review.
Approved records can proceed to clinician-facing triage preparation.
Low-confidence or ambiguous records require staff review before use.
Invalid records are rejected with issues preserved for follow-up.
